id: title:Gilbert09:skip zones where the legacy firewall rules api is gone

review.posthog_relevance: Cloudflare warehouse ingestion connector: Prevents ingestion stream abortion when Cloudflare returns HTTP 410 Gone for deprecated Firewall Rules and Filters APIs, allowing the connector to skip retired resources and continue fetching other zone resources.
review.reason: Adds HTTP status code 410 to skipped status codes, preventing ingestion stream abortion for deprecated Cloudflare APIs.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies solely on the provided hunk and its description; no broader system behavior or test results are supplied to verify complete implementation or edge-case handling.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No abstention.

observations.behavior: Adds HTTP status code 410 (Gone) to the list of skipped status codes for Cloudflare firewall rules and filters, alongside the existing 400. This allows the ingestion connector to continue processing other resources when a zone's API has been retired rather than treating it as a transient or forbidden error.
observations.posthog_connection: Cloudflare warehouse ingestion: Cloudflare deprecated the legacy Firewall Rules and Filters APIs. When a zone has moved to the new Ruleset Engine, the legacy endpoints return 410 Gone. This change prevents the warehouse ingestion stream from aborting when encountering these retired endpoints, allowing the connector to skip the unavailable resource and continue fetching other zone-1
